final_answer.key_evidence_summary: Namespace boutique pod scan shows a single outlier: shippingservice-546b9d5bcb-42mk8 is 0/1 (Ready=False, ContainersReady=False) while all other 10 pods are 1/1 Running; Restart Count is 0, so no crash-loop. Pod events show 'Warning Unhealthy ... Readiness probe failed: Get "http://172.20.2.113:50051/": net/http: HTTP/1.x transport connection broken: malformed HTTP response "\x00\x00\x06\x04..."' (x10 over 83s) — the returned bytes are an HTTP/2 frame, indicating the port speaks gRPC rather than HTTP. GetAppYAML(shippingservice) confirms the mismatch: livenessProbe uses grpc on port 50051 (correct), but readinessProbe uses httpGet path=/ on port 50051, while the container's only port 50051 is exposed as the Service's 'grpc' port. Container logs show 'Shipping Service listening on port :50051', i.e. the process is healthy and serving gRPC; the httpGet readiness probe can never succeed, so the pod never becomes Ready and is kept out of the Service endpoints.
